hook: Their 87-foot boat was flooding. All five had to abandon ship.
narration: Five fishermen, and an eighty-seven foot boat flooding off Washington.
The Sunnfjord was taking on water off Cape Alava, and pumping had failed.
So they abandoned ship, into the January Pacific, one at a time.
A forty-seven foot motor lifeboat from Coast Guard Station Quillayute River was waiting alongside.
These lifeboats are built to roll over and right themselves, so they can work close to a sinking ship.
One by one, the lifeboat crew pulled all five fishermen out of the water.
outcome: The lifeboat carried all five to Station Neah Bay with no reported medical concerns.
title: Five abandon a sinking fishing boat
description:
A 47-foot Motor Life Boat crew from Coast Guard Station Quillayute River pulled five fishermen from the water as they abandoned the flooding 87-foot Sunnfjord off Cape Alava, Washington, on Jan. 31, 2018.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Alexander Warriner, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/582666/coast-guard-rescues-5-fishermen-flooding-ship
